purpose: Controlled reproduction attempt of the 24 September Kate/Qt SIGSEGV (QSortFilterProxyModel::data) using owned fixtures only

fixtures.kdialog_save_dialog: kdialog --getsavefilename on an owned 300-file acceptance directory (same KDE file widget/proxy model family as Kate Save As)
fixtures.fresh_kate: kate --startanon on an owned fixture.txt; its owned 'Save session' dialog opened through Kate's exported QAction (no input)

runs.error_kind: atspi 'No such object path' for item-view rows removed mid-read

interpretation: Item-view rows are volatile during model updates (9 vanished-object errors in the unrestricted dump). The hardened traversal never enumerates Qt item-view rows unless one exact item is requested, and aborts rather than continues when the application disappears. This reduces exposure; it is not a proven fix for the historical crash.
